Among 2020-2024 papers containing "untransformed" , 37.6% of significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) – i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a higher than the typical neuroscience paper (median shown for reference). Relative to other words, "untransformed" papers are in the top 73rd percentile in terms of fragile p-value percentage (lower = better). Note, p-values highly predict replicability (see the associated paper).
